reviews.title: Would not recommend unless you like to listen to static
reviews.body: Have an automatic ambient sound mode that can't be disabled. Sounds like extremely loud white noise/static that overpowers whatever you try to listen to. Apparently it's a default design feature that isn't advertised.

reviews.title: Love My JBL Vibes
reviews.body: Great range and outside noise gone when you have them on. Well worth the money. I charged the battery on Sunday and didn't recharge them again until this Sunday only because I'm getting them ready for another week of work.

reviews.title: Good quality
reviews.body: Very good sound quality for the money. Pretty decent bass response. I wasn't too keen on the app, but it's actually pretty handy and I like that it has an equalizer.

reviews.title: Great 40$ earbuds
reviews.body: Had the original jbl vibe beam and they did the job great, a bit bulkier than these ones, lost one of them so bought a pair of skull candy's that were almost too sleek to the point of being difficult to take out of the case. The skullcandys would however shift off the charging contacts and connect to my phone at random times especially when I'm on a phonecall leading to much frustration. These are secure easy to handle and case is very pocketable. Sound quality is clear and defined, plenty of bass but not overly eq'd, balanced and adequate. Good for a beater pair of cheapies that I'll probably lose 1 within a year

reviews.title: I would recommend!
reviews.body: My kids love these, good quality, batteries last good, fits right, sounds good too!
